paragraphs: Logistics clearing agents and freight transport operators in India process millions of regional vernacular transport bills, lorry receipts (LR), and fuel receipts issued in regional languages including Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, and Gujarati. Standard cloud OCR engines fail on complex Indic compound characters, degraded dot-matrix printouts, and multi-lingual layout mixing. Accounts teams spend weeks manually keying data, introducing severe data entry errors and delaying GST input tax credit reconciliation.

Our sovereign bilingual OCR architecture deploys specialized multi-script deep learning vision models on local edge servers. Ingress document scans are pre-processed to remove background noise, skew, and thermal degradation. The optical recognition engine identifies mixed English and Indic character strings, mapping driver names, vehicle registration numbers, consignment weights, and freight charges into structured JSON data.

The automated voucher entry state machine maps extracted line items directly to vendor ledgers in Tally Prime via the local port 9000 XML interface. It cross-checks transport bill numbers against existing goods receipt notes to prevent duplicate payments. If an unmapped vendor name or tax rate variance is detected, the transaction halts for supervisor classification while valid vouchers are posted in under 45ms.

Statutory compliance conforms to Section 16 of the CGST Act for input tax credit eligibility and Section 8(5) of the DPDP Act 2023. The bilingual agent achieves 99.4% character recognition accuracy across regional Indian scripts, reducing voucher processing costs by 84% and cutting back-office data entry backlogs from weeks to minutes.

faqs.question: Can the system parse mixed English and Tamil invoices with handwritten delivery notes?
faqs.answer: Yes. The vision model separates printed typography from handwritten endorsements, transcribing both with specialized regional handwriting recognition weights.

faqs.question: How does the system map regional vendor names to existing Tally ledger accounts?
faqs.answer: The engine utilizes phonetic Indian language matching to correlate regional transliterations with canonical legal names registered in Tally Prime.

faqs.question: Does this solution require an active internet connection to process regional language OCR?
faqs.answer: No. All deep learning vision models and language dictionaries run 100% on local edge servers within the company's private network.
